row:
I find horses in unexpected places and help them reach their full potential. 

Learn tips and tricks as I go to auctions looking for diamonds in the rough!

Although I do buy horses in need of "rescue" I am NOT a rescue. 
Just one person trying to make a difference in the world one horse at a time!
 


~Help out by SUBSCRIBING, LIKING videos, and SHARING with a friend!
~I've created a special membership for fans.  You can earn loyalty badges and get access to custom emojis of the horses and Tiny!
~For those of you who are moved by the work I do and want to say thank you another way, I do have an Amazon wishlist
https://www.amazon.com/hz/wishlist/ls/30SJMSAO011KD?ref_=wl_share
~ You can now also "buy a bale of hay" for your favorite horse! 
https://www.buymeacoffee.com/theclevercowgirl


~ Snail Mail ~
The Clever Cowgirl
2536 RIMROCK AVE STE 400,  BOX 325
GRAND JUNCTION, CO 81505-8667
